name: Transcriptomic partial-reprogramming portability benchmark
description: Code, frozen protocols and configurations, hashes, tests, aggregate results, figure sources and the preprint edition of the manuscript for: Five chronological-age transcriptomic directions fail a locked portability benchmark across partial-reprogramming interventions. This archive is the exact GitHub release v1.0.0 (commit eded304338366ce67402c299d0ce64f4a73af4c3). Source code is Apache-2.0; manuscripts, protocols, figures and newly authored aggregate tables are CC BY 4.0. Raw public expression matrices are referenced by GEO accession and are not redistributed.
